basic_info.description: Welcome to 1317 Hyde Street, #4, a 2br, 1.25ba home located in the heart of Nob Hill, offering unparalleled views of the Golden Gate Bridge and San Francisco Bay. This Edwardian home combines classic charm with modern upgrades. From both the living room and master bedroom, enjoy breathtaking views of the bridge and the Bay. The spacious living and dining rooms are flooded with light, accentuated by large windows that frame the iconic views. Pocket doors, crown molding, and other details add character to the home, while the newly remodeled kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and sleek stone counters. The primary bedroom offers a serene retreat with Golden Gate views visible right from the king-sized bed. A spacious 2nd br provides flexibility for an office, guests, or more living space. Both bedrooms include closets with built-in storage, and the updated split bath features newly installed finishes, blending contemporary touches with the home's historic character.  This home offers more than just views-it provides practical amenities like a full-size laundry room, updated electrical, and an XL storage room perfect for bikes and more. Also enjoy a charming shared garden w/ barbecue area, a peaceful space to unwind.
